text.p: New Nigerian coach Phillipe Troussier recalled strikers Efan Ekoku and Christopher Ohenhen on Tuesday for next month's crucial World Cup qualifier against fellow West Africans Guinea.
Frenchman Troussier, appointed last month, included Wimbledon's Ekoku and Compostela's Ohenhen in a 23-man squad for the April 5 game.
Troussier replaced coach Amodu Shaibu, sacked in January after coming in for Dutchman Jo Bonfrere, who quit in October after alleging poor treatment and interference in his duties.

Olympic champions Nigeria, second behind Guinea in their group, must win to keep alive their chances of qualifying for the 1998 World Cup finals in France. Only one team will qualify from the group of four.
Ekoku and Ohenhen have each scored 11 league goals this season.
Ekoku last played for Nigeria in 1995, while uncapped Ohenhen was on the substitutes' bench in 1990.
Goalkeepers - Ike Shorounmu (FC Zurich), Willy Okpara (Orlando Pirates), Abiodun Baruwa (Shooting Stars).

Defenders - Mobi Oparaku (Turnhout), Celestine Babayaro (Anderlecht), Godwin Okpara (Strasbourg), Taribo West (Auxerre), Austin Eguavoen (CSKA Moscow), Uche Okechukwu (Fenerbahce), Ajibade Babalade (Shooting Stars).

Midfielders - Sunday Oliseh (Cologne), Austin "Jay-Jay" Okocha (Fenerbahce), Wilson Oruma (Nancy), Garba Lawal (FC Utrecht), Finidi George (Real Betis), Emmanuel Amunike (Barcelona), Mutiu Adepoju (Real Sociedad).
Strikers - Efan Ekoku (Wimbledon), Christopher Ohenhen (Compostela), Jonathan Akpoborie (Hansa Rostock), Daniel Amokachi (Besiktas), Victor Ikpeba (Monaco), Tijjani Babangida (Ajax).
